name: CeMarkingAffixed
description: The CE marking is affixed to the product or its documentation

name: ComponentDueDiligence
description: Due diligence is exercised for third-party components, including open source components

name: ConformityRouteCompleted
description: The conformity assessment procedure for the product class is carried out

name: CorruptionReported
description: Corruption of data, programs or configuration is detected and reported

name: CvdPolicyPublished
description: A coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy is published

name: DataProcessingJustified
description: It is documented which data the product processes and why each item is necessary for the intended use

name: DataRemovalDescribed
description: It is documented how users remove all data and settings, or that the product stores none

name: DataTransferSecure
description: Data transfer to other products or systems is secure

name: DebugInterfacesProtected
description: Debug and service interfaces are disabled or protected in the delivered product

name: DeclarationOfConformityIssued
description: An EU declaration of conformity according to Annex V exists for the released version

name: DocumentationRetained
description: Technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity are retained for the required period

name: EssentialFunctionsIdentified
description: The essential and basic functions of the product are identified and documented

name: EssentialFunctionsResilient
description: Essential functions remain available under attack or fault conditions

name: ExploitationMitigationApplied
description: Exploitation mitigation techniques (hardening flags, memory protection, sandboxing) are applied

name: ExploitedVulnerabilitiesReportedInTime
description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities are reported within the required time limits

name: FixedVulnerabilitiesDisclosed
description: An advisory with the required information is published for every fixed vulnerability

name: ImpactOnOtherServicesAssessed
description: The impact of the product on services of other devices or networks is assessed and documented

name: IncidentImpactReductionDesigned
description: The design and documentation say how the impact of an incident is reduced

name: KeysProtected
description: Cryptographic keys and secrets are stored in protected storage

name: NoDefaultCredentials
description: The product has no default or shared credentials

name: ProductClassDetermined
description: The product class is determined and documented

name: ProductIdentified
description: The product type, version or batch and the manufacturer are identified on or with the product

name: ReportingProcessDefined
description: A process for reporting exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents is defined and tested

name: ResetToOriginalStatePossible
description: The product can be reset to its original secure state

name: RiskAssessmentDocumented
description: A cybersecurity risk assessment of the product is documented and has been approved

name: RiskAssessmentUpdated
description: The cybersecurity risk assessment is reviewed and updated at defined intervals and after relevant changes

name: SbomAvailable
description: A machine-readable SBOM exists for each release of the product

name: SbomComplete
description: The SBOM is valid and covers at least the top-level dependencies

name: SecureBootEnabled
description: The product verifies the integrity and origin of the software it starts

name: SecurityPatchesFree
description: Security patches are provided free of charge with advisory messages

name: SecurityPatchesTimely
description: Security patches are disseminated without delay

name: SecurityRelevantActivityDefined
description: The security relevant internal activity and how it is recorded or monitored are defined and documented

name: SecurityTestingRegular
description: Security tests and scans run regularly and for every release

name: SecurityUpdatesPossible
description: The product can receive and install security updates

name: SecurityUpdatesSeparable
description: Security updates are provided separately from functionality updates where technically feasible

name: SevereIncidentsReportedInTime
description: Severe incidents are reported within the required time limits

name: SoftwareIntegrityProtected
description: Software and firmware integrity is protected (signed updates, secure boot or equivalent)

name: StoredDataProtected
description: Stored confidential data is protected by suitable technical means

name: SupportPeriodCommunicated
description: The support period is stated to users

name: SupportPeriodDetermined
description: A support period of at least five years (or a justified shorter period) is determined

name: TechnicalDocumentationComplete
description: The technical documentation is complete according to Annex VII and up to date

name: TransmittedDataProtected
description: Transmitted confidential data is protected by suitable technical means

name: UpdatesDistributedSecurely
description: Updates are signed, distributed over an authenticated channel and verified before installation

name: UserInformationProvided
description: User information and instructions according to Annex II are provided

name: UsersInformedOfIncidents
description: Affected users are informed about exploited vulnerabilities, incidents and corrective measures

name: VulnerabilityContactProvided
description: A contact address for vulnerability reports is provided and monitored

name: VulnerabilityRemediationTimely
description: Known vulnerabilities are triaged and remediated within the defined time
